The '''Golden Globe Award for Best Actor in a Motion Picture – Musical or Comedy''' is a [[Golden Globe Awards|Golden Globe Award]] first presented by the [[Hollywood Foreign Press Association]]. It is given in honor of an actor who has delivered an outstanding performance in a [[Leading actor|leading role]] in a musical or comedy film. Previously, there was a single award for "Best Actor in a Motion Picture", but the creation of the category in 1951 allowed for recognition of it and the [[Golden Globe Award for Best Actor in a Motion Picture – Drama|Best Actor – Drama]].

The formal title has varied since its inception. In 2006, it was officially called: "Best Performance by an Actor in a Motion Picture – Musical or Comedy". {{as of|2013}}, the wording is "Best Actor in a Motion Picture – Musical or Comedy".

== Multiple character nominations ==
Winners are in '''bold'''.
* [[Inspector Clouseau|Inspector Jacques Clouseau]] from ''[[The Pink Panther (1963 film)|The Pink Panther]]'' <small>([[Peter Sellers]], 1963)</small>, ''[[The Return of the Pink Panther]]'' <small>(Peter Sellers, 1975)</small>, and ''[[The Pink Panther Strikes Again]]'' <small>(Peter Sellers, 1976)</small>
* [[Willy Wonka]] from ''[[Willy Wonka & the Chocolate Factory]]'' <small>([[Gene Wilder]], 1971)</small>, ''[[Charlie and the Chocolate Factory (film)|Charlie and the Chocolate Factory]]'' <small>([[Johnny Depp]], 2005)</small>, and ''[[Wonka (film)|Wonka]]'' <small>([[Timothée Chalamet]], 2023)</small>
* [[Knives Out (film series)#Recurring cast and characters|Benoit Blanc]] from ''[[Knives Out]]'' <small>([[Daniel Craig]], 2019)</small> and ''[[Glass Onion: A Knives Out Mystery]]'' <small>(Daniel Craig, 2022)</small>

==Firsts==
* [[Cantinflas]] became the first Latino as well as the first Mexican actor to win in [[14th Golden Globe Awards|1957]].
* [[Marcello Mastroianni]] became the first actor to win for a foreign language/non-English language performance in [[20th Golden Globe Awards|1963]].
* [[Chaim Topol|Topol]] became the first actor of Asian descent to win in [[29th Golden Globe Awards|1972]].
* [[Morgan Freeman]] became the first actor of African descent to win in [[47th Golden Globe Awards|1990]].
* [[Sacha Baron Cohen]] became the first actor to win for playing the same character ([[Borat Sagdiyev]]) twice in [[64th Golden Globe Awards|2006]] and [[78th Golden Globe Awards|2021]].
